_comment: Addendum 2). division_rate moves the population count; cell_volume moves the
cluster radius AT FIXED count. Those are the two directions (log_n, log_r95)
resolves, and the pair is measured at |cos| 0.07 -- against 0.86 for the
division/motility pair, which is why that one gives a ridge and this one does not.
motility is fixed: it is 0.82-0.86 confounded with division_rate and its ABC
posterior is the prior at every setting screened.
